title: A landing page built around MIRROR's moat
decision: What should MIRROR's landing page say, show and sequence, and what is the moat it is built around?

options.label: Moat-first story page with a distinct look
Keep today's calm page and polish it
Demo-first page: a real try-it in the hero, moat story below

hormozi.reason: The offer, the headline, the proof and the call to action decide whether the page converts

blakely.reason: Brand and feel: does a nervous candidate feel safe and want to tell a friend

graham.reason: Is the page for real users with real demand, and honest about a pre-beta product

buffett.reason: What is the durable moat, and does every claim stay literally true (trust)

brief: The founder wants a landing page of the same kind as hiringant.ai but built around MIRROR's moat, in a creative look of its own. MIRROR is pre-beta with no testimonials or numbers. Options A to D range from a moat-first story page to a demo-first page.
assumptions: A handful of testers, no revenue (assumed)
